Questions, answered plainly

Understanding Oakbridge.

Clear expectations are part of building safety and trust.

What is Oakbridge Business Academy?+

Oakbridge is a trauma-informed micro-enterprise academy. It combines practical business education, mentoring, systems and staged support so participants can build capability, income, routine and wellbeing through enterprise.

Who is the pathway designed for?+

It is designed for high-potential people facing high barriers, including justice-impacted aspiring entrepreneurs, who are ready for practical learning, structure and accountable support.

Is Oakbridge a “second chance” programme?+

No. Oakbridge leads with capability and future identity, not deficit. The focus is on building a credible route to economic agency rather than defining a person by what came before.

Does every participant have to launch a business?+

No. If enterprise is not the right next step, Oakbridge keeps the person in the fold and supports a restart, a pivot or an employment pathway.

How will progress be measured?+

Oakbridge is designed to track change against a baseline across wellbeing, capability, income, routine, connection and legal stability — while being honest about attribution and the support still required.
